$comment: Forge-Off themed events. Each event is a run of daily boards over the same auth-free vote pipeline as the weekly Forge-Off. Add an event by adding an object here: api/_lib/forge-off-events.js validates it at load and the /forge-off page, /api/forge-off/event, /api/forge-gallery?event= and the crown cron all read it. Dates are UTC. `days` must be consecutive calendar dates starting on starts_at's date. The first event uses the proposed week for the IBM community event; move the dates here when they are confirmed.

events.title: The Forge-Off Open
events.summary: Five days, five themes, one board and one small prize per day. Describe a thing in one sentence, get a real textured 3D model, publish it, and vote. No account.

days.theme: The object your job wishes existed
Give it a face and a name
Put it in your actual room

events.prizes_note: One small prize per daily board and one for the overall winner. Prizes are set by the organizers of the event.
